title: Common Crawl body acquisition was blocked in the historical runtime
claim: Under the frozen E1605 contract, the historical runtime did not obtain parameterized CDX results or exact WARC response bytes, so zero captures entered the SHA-512 test and the required acquisition-blocked status applied.
why_it_matters: It separates an infrastructure limitation from a false claim that the selected crawls contain no relevant capture.
controls: No live-page, reconstructed-body, filename, or synthetic substitute was permitted.
limitations: The result says nothing about whether relevant captures exist.
The historical network environment cannot be fully reconstructed from the preserved package.
does_not_claim: That Common Crawl contains no relevant Tor2web capture.
That any Page 73 external artifact has been recovered.
current_interpretation: A valid acquisition null and provenance boundary, not a content-search negative.
